
SASBDB entry SASDKY3  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDKY3/)

Publication: 101-nt Varkud satellite ribozyme, NMR-SAXS structure
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkab963

Files are SASBDB downloads (sasbdb.org/media/): experimental_data/SASDKY3.dat, SASDKY3_fit1.fit, SASDKY3_fit1_model1.pdb. Nothing was modified.
Buffer 50 mM MES pH 6.5, 50 mM KCl, 5 mM MgCl2 and 20 C: paper (Methods, SAXS data
collection and analysis) and SASBDB. Wavelength 0.134 nm: SASBDB only (the paper's Supplementary
Table S1 was not read). The .fit is CRYSOL, header "Chi^2: 1.197" (a chi2; recomputed 1.2021).

q cut (round 9, 2026-11-13): the script fits q <= 0.3 A^-1 and leaves out the noise tail: S/N about 2 at 0.3, noise floor beyond; above the cut 43 of 213 points non-positive (first at 0.345), mean I/sigma 1.0.
Every other entry without such a tail is fitted over its whole curve.
